javaOnlyFiles.ControllerSupport: Desktop JInput controller discovery is replaced by the browser input layer.
javaOnlyFiles.JackalAppGameContainer: Desktop Slick2D container behavior is replaced by the PWA shell and AppGameContainer integration.
javaOnlyFiles.LoadingMode: Browser resource preparation and loading UI are owned by the PWA shell.
javaOnlyFiles.NativeDpadPolicy: Native JInput name and legacy-index compatibility policy; browser standard mapping classification intentionally differs.

typescriptOnlyFiles.AudioRegistry: Browser save-state persistence assigns stable IDs to Jackal Sound objects without changing Java gameplay semantics.
typescriptOnlyFiles.MainRuntimeState: Breaks ESM circular dependencies while preserving Java-style global runtime ownership.
typescriptOnlyFiles.GameTileTypes: Cycle-safe source of truth for tile type constants shared by GameMode and translated entities.
typescriptOnlyFiles.PlayerMotionConstants: Cycle-safe source of truth for Player motion constants and precomputed rumble values used by cutscenes.
typescriptOnlyFiles.JackalMath: Provides a cycle-safe, Java-float-compatible rotation helper shared by Main and Player.
typescriptOnlyFiles.JackalResources: Provides the browser resource-loading boundary for Jackal packed data files.
typescriptOnlyFiles.SoundCooldownClock: Browser-only monotonic cooldown clock freezes during PWA suspension; the durable contract remains relative remaining milliseconds.
typescriptOnlyFiles.CutsceneState: Browser-only durable ordered cutscene bag IDs and validation; desktop retains its existing runtime bag.
typescriptOnlyFiles.ScorePresentation: Shared browser-derived numeric score formatting for restore-safe ending presentation; Java init uses the equivalent canonical numeric format.

ButtonMapping.VERSION.reason: Browser input persistence is versioned by JackalInputMappingStore instead of Java Preferences.

Explosion.enemy.reason: Java field hiding requires a separate JavaScript property from GameElement.enemy.

Fire.enemy.reason: Java field hiding requires a separate JavaScript property from GameElement.enemy.

IntroMode.FULL_SCREEN_TEXT.reason: The Java desktop title screen documents its Space fullscreen control; the PWA owns fullscreen in the browser menu and deliberately omits this instruction.

IntroMode.FULL_SCREEN_TEXT_X.reason: The browser omits the Java-only fullscreen title instruction and therefore does not need its layout coordinate.

IntroMode.FULL_SCREEN_TEXT_Y.reason: The browser omits the Java-only fullscreen title instruction and therefore does not need its layout coordinate.

Main.controllers.reason: Browser gamepads are discovered through the browser input layer.

Main.fullscreenFallbackActive.reason: Browser fullscreen fallback is owned by the PWA shell.

Main.fullscreenHeight.reason: Browser fullscreen sizing is owned by the PWA shell.

Main.fullscreenWidth.reason: Browser fullscreen sizing is owned by the PWA shell.

Main.mouseCursorHidden.reason: Cursor hiding is owned by JackalWebApp.

Main.nativeDisplayMode.reason: Desktop display mode state has no browser equivalent.

Main.title.reason: Avoids colliding with BasicGame's private title field while preserving the loaded title art.

Main.appGameContainer.reason: The browser AppGameContainer is owned by JackalWebApp rather than duplicated on the gameplay object.

Main.scalableGame.reason: Browser native-resolution buffering and scaling are owned by JackalWebApp.

Player.RUMBLE_STEPS.reason: The browser keeps this cycle-safe shared constant in PlayerMotionConstants as PLAYER_RUMBLE_STEPS.

Main.nativeCursor.reason: The Java desktop keeps native cursor state for its legacy fullscreen lifecycle; browser cursor/fullscreen presentation is owned by the PWA shell.

Main.hiddenCursor.reason: The Java desktop keeps a hidden cursor for its legacy fullscreen lifecycle; browser cursor/fullscreen presentation is owned by the PWA shell.

InputMode.controllerDownDown.reason: The browser mapper tracks direction levels per logical controller so reconnect generations and multiple controllers can be baselined independently; Java desktop keeps one aggregate direction latch.

Song.lastLifePausedPart.reason: Runtime-only native Music reference holds the exact paused part until Music policy permits resume. Browser Music exposes logical paused transport directly; only lastLifeSuspended is durable audio intent.

ButtonMapping.save.reason: Browser persistence is handled by JackalInputMappingStore.

Main.fullScreenToggleCheck.reason: Java retains legacy Space/Escape desktop fullscreen polling; the browser PWA shell owns fullscreen and menu transitions.

Main.showMouseCursor.reason: Java desktop cursor restoration is part of its legacy fullscreen lifecycle; browser presentation is owned by the PWA shell.

Main.hideMouseCursor.reason: Java desktop cursor hiding is part of its legacy fullscreen lifecycle; browser presentation is owned by the PWA shell.

HumanInput.isFullscreenTogglePressed.reason: Java retains legacy Space desktop fullscreen input; the browser PWA shell owns fullscreen and leaves Space available as a remappable gameplay key.

HumanInput.isEscape.reason: Java retains legacy Escape desktop fullscreen input; the browser PWA shell owns Escape as the return-to-menu command.

IInput.isFullscreenTogglePressed.reason: The Java input interface exposes its legacy desktop fullscreen toggle; browser fullscreen is owned by the PWA shell instead.

IInput.isEscape.reason: The Java input interface exposes its legacy Escape fullscreen control; browser Escape is reserved by the PWA shell for returning to the menu.

InputMode.sampleControllerBinding.reason: Native adapter snapshot consumer corresponds to the browser generation-aware sampler.

Song.resumeHeldPartWhenEnabled.reason: Native-only resume gate preserves the user Music preference and resumes the stored paused part once. Browser playback generations enforce application policy while retaining logical transport.

enumMemberExceptions.Modes.LOADING: Browser loading is owned by JackalWebApp rather than a gameplay mode.

behaviorExceptions.ButtonMapping.browserFullscreenKeys: Java reserves Space and Escape for its desktop fullscreen controls. The PWA reserves only Escape for its browser menu, leaving Space as a normal remappable gameplay key.
behaviorExceptions.IntroMode.browserFullscreenInstruction: Java displays its Space fullscreen instruction on the title screen. The PWA deliberately omits that line because fullscreen belongs to the browser menu.
behaviorExceptions.Main.update.fadeTiming: The browser advances the 23-level screen fade from Jackal's existing 10 ms fixed-update loop. This intentionally removes the Java desktop version's display-refresh dependency while leaving the Java source unchanged.
behaviorExceptions.GameMode.browserPauseMusicTransport: Java uses GameContainer.setMusicOn(false/true) for gameplay Pause. The browser keeps application-wide Music policy in the PWA shell and pauses/resumes the exact active Song Music transport instead, preserving the same user-visible pause behavior without leaking game state into page-global audio policy.
behaviorExceptions.Main.browserFullscreenOwnership: Java keeps its Space/Escape Slick fullscreen lifecycle. The PWA shell owns browser fullscreen entry, exit, fallback, and menu transitions instead.
